newsitem.title: USA: Martin Marietta Materials sees demand growth.
newsitem.headline: Martin Marietta Materials sees demand growth.

text.p: Martin Marietta Materials Inc said Tuesday that demand for construction aggregates remains strong, especially in the Southeast.
Aggregates division sales in the first quarter rose 20 percent from a year earlier to $124.1 million, it said.

"Based upon current economic forecasts regarding growth within the construction industry, we believe the division will continue to see moderate overall growth in demand for its aggregates products for the full year 1997," President Stephen Zelnak Jr said in a statement.

The Magnesia Specialites division had sales of $34.1 million, up four percent from the same period in 1996. Operating net fell $0.5 million to $2.5 million, but Zelnak said the division remains on target for sales and earnings improvement in 1997.
